description:
Location: Sunnyvale, CA
Position: Java Integration Developer
Need:
• Java
• Apache Camel (can have a similar tool like Mulesoft, but Camel is preferred)
• Rest API’s
• Big Data-Kafka and Cassandra
• Spring framework


Industry: Retail experience is preferred based on the project, but can come from any industry as long as experience is relevant. 

Interview Mode: Phone and then WebEx. Candidates DO NOT need to be local but will need to be onsite for the project. 
Length: 1 year +(most people stay on for 2-3 years)



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
